name: bwca

attributes.attribute: a Welsh form of the sprite recorded as bucca

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The bwca is a Welsh form of the sprite that the encyclopedia records as bucca. This entry sends the reader to the bucca entry for the fuller account of this household being.

okr.objective: Route the reader to the fuller bucca entry.
key_results: Bwca is a Welsh variant name for the bucca.
The fuller account of this household being sits under bucca.
